title: If a box furnace controls temperature automatically, does loading still need an operator?
summary: Programme temperature control and loading method need separate confirmation. Jiangsu Suneng Industrial Furnace Co., Ltd.'s box-furnace proposal dated 21 November 2024 uses instruments for heating, holding and cooling, alongside an operator-controlled electric fork trolley for raising, lowering and moving the frame. Electric mechanisms and wireless door operation do not establish fully automatic handling. Define the relationship between operators, frame, forks and door first.
